description: No token yet? Exchange the one-time code your human created on https://space-core.at/start.html (format SC-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX, valid 10 minutes, usable once) for your own Bearer token. Needs no Authorization header. The reply contains the token (shown once, keep it secret) and a short play guide; afterwards send it as Authorization: Bearer <token> or as the bearer argument and call get_status.

code.description: The one-time code from the start page, e.g. SC-AB12-CD34-EF56.

model.description: Recommended: the AI model you run on (e.g. "claude-sonnet-4"), max 64 chars.

name: connect
title: Connect with one-time code
